name: Your Company
tagline: A sofa in your colour — in 7 days
niche: Online store of sofas and upholstered furniture made in-house

listing.description: A store site for a sofa and upholstered furniture maker. On the first screen visitors recolour the sofa with fabric swatches, models are cards with silhouettes, and the week to delivery is a road with a van.

seo.title: Your Company — made-to-order sofas in Tashkent in 7 days
seo.description: Straight, corner and modular sofas, armchairs and poufs made in-house. Six fabrics to choose from, removable covers, delivery across Tashkent in 7 days, 3-year warranty.
seo.answer: Your Company is a store of sofas made in-house, with a showroom at 7 Mukimi St in Tashkent. A three-seater starts at 7,900,000 UZS, a corner sofa at 11,400,000 UZS, an armchair at 3,200,000 UZS. Six fabrics, removable covers, delivery and carry-up across Tashkent in 7 days, 3-year warranty. The showroom is open daily, 10:00–20:00.

sections.title: A sofa made just for you
sections.subtitle: Pick a model and an upholstery — we will sew the sofa in our own workshop and bring it in a week. You can touch the fabrics at our Mukimi showroom.

sections.label: Models
sections.title: Seven models — any of six fabrics
sections.intro: Prices are for the model in the base fabric. Colour changes are free; bouclé and corduroy add 10%.

sections.label: Delivery
sections.title: One week from order to sofa

items.title: Day 1 — order
items.text: You choose the model and fabric and pay a deposit.

items.title: Day 2 — cutting
items.text: We cut the fabric and prepare the frame.

items.title: Days 3–5 — sewing
items.text: We assemble the frame, fit the springs and sew the covers.

items.title: Day 6 — inspection
items.text: We check the seams and mechanisms and send you a photo.

items.title: Day 7 — delivery
items.text: We deliver, carry it up and remove the wrapping.

sections.label: At home
sections.title: How they live with our customers

items.quote: We picked the fabric at the showroom and a week later the sofa was at home. We wash the covers in the machine — a lifesaver with kids.
items.author: Malika

items.quote: They assembled the corner sofa in 20 minutes and moved the corner to the other side straight away — just as promised.
items.author: Bobur

items.quote: We bought two armchairs for the study. Soft to sit on, and your back never tires.
items.author: Nargiza

items.q: Will the sofa really arrive in 7 days?
items.a: Yes, for every catalogue model in the six main fabrics. The date goes into the contract; modular sets of more than five sections take up to 10 days.

items.q: Can I see the fabrics in person?
items.a: Yes, all swatches are at the showroom at 7 Mukimi St. We can also bring swatches to your home for free.

items.q: Do the covers really come off?
items.a: Yes, on every model except “Guest”. Wash them at 30 °C or have them dry-cleaned.
Delivery and carry-up are free within Tashkent. Outside the city at the carrier’s rate.
Yes, through partner instalment services for 6 or 12 months. A manager will explain the terms.
